tools.name: continue_debugging
tools.description: Continue the paused Sema debugger and wait for its next stable state.

tools.name: find_examples
tools.description: Find bundled Sema examples by filename, category, or identifier.

query.description: Case-insensitive text used to filter examples.

tools.name: format_editor
tools.description: Format the current Sema source in the playground editor.

tools.name: get_debug_state
tools.description: Read debugger status, active line, breakpoints, locals, and stack frames.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List one directory in the playground virtual filesystem.

dir.description: Absolute virtual directory path to list.

tools.name: load_example
tools.description: Load one bundled Sema example into the editor by identifier or filename.

id.description: Example identifier such as getting-started/hello.sema or hello.sema.

tools.name: read_editor
tools.description: Read Sema source from the playground editor. Use this before editing or running unfamiliar code.

offset.description: Zero-based character offset at which to start reading.

limit.description: Maximum number of characters to return.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the playground virtual filesystem.

path.description: Absolute virtual file path to read.

offset.description: Zero-based character offset at which to start reading.

limit.description: Maximum number of characters to return.

tools.name: read_output
tools.description: Read the current playground output, including values, printed lines, errors, and timing.

offset.description: Zero-based character offset at which to start reading.

limit.description: Maximum number of characters to return.

tools.name: run_editor
tools.description: Run the current Sema source and wait for evaluation to finish.

tools.name: set_breakpoints
tools.description: Replace the debugger breakpoints with the requested one-based source lines.

lines.description: One-based editor line numbers on which to pause.

tools.name: start_debugging
tools.description: Start debugging the current Sema source and wait for a pause, finish, or error.

tools.name: step_debugger
tools.description: Step the paused Sema debugger into, over, or out and wait for its next stable state.

tools.name: stop_debugging
tools.description: Stop the active Sema debugger and return the playground to its idle state.

tools.name: stop_run
tools.description: Cancel the active worker-backed Sema evaluation when one is running.

tools.name: write_editor
tools.description: Replace the playground editor contents with Sema source code.

code.description: Complete Sema source to place in the editor.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 text file in the playground virtual filesystem.

path.description: Absolute virtual file path to create or replace.

content.description: UTF-8 text content, limited to 1 MiB.
